title: Lanes merge their own claude-settings PRs
ruling: Owner's words, verbatim, 11:12 CST Nov 15, via the consultant (ruling own-consultant-speaks-for-owner): "lanes can merge claude settings prs yes i thought thats alrdy decided". Question this answers: who merges claude-settings PRs. The consultant's page item of 11:08 CST was never posted (triage declined it because main already ruled otherwise), so the owner answered in chat; no page item exists. The act it names: lanes merge their own claude-settings PRs. It overturns decision standing-merge-grant (docs/decisions/standing-merge-grant.md on main, line 16: "A lane that a coordinator started never merges. Owner, 19:23 CST, on the option that lets such a lane merge its own PR: `option C absolutely not correct`", 2026-11-01). Decisions standing-merge-grant and session-tiers (lines about 72-75, 87, 102) still say the opposite on main; a docs lane must rewrite them in place (step rewrite-merge-decisions-for-lane-merge). || The consultant's reading of 11:18 CST (confirmed by the consultant 11:30), replacing its 11:15 reading (its pick, not the owner's; relayed, not read by triage): a lane never marks its own PR ready; runner 10 marks it; a lane merges on 'marked and green' with `merge --confirm`. It loosens nothing else: no red main, no classifier or override refusal, nothing for other repos. The standing grant 'Lane draft PR' in claude-settings .claude/CLAUDE.md (only the batch runner marks ready) is consistent with it. || Unasked: whether the owner wants anything beyond the consultant's 11:18 reading. Code lane: lane-merges-own-pr-code.
quote: lanes can merge claude settings prs yes i thought thats alrdy decided
